title: A lot of good page-turners mysteries included.
text:
After receiving 10 boxes, I had to put the subscription on hold because of a lack of space and a long reading backlog.
However, I'm happy with it and I will subscribe again.
Here are my pros and cons, some are just personal preferences.

PROS
1 All the books are clearly new.
2 Most of them were real page-turners that I really enjoyed reading. That's why I will subscribe again.
3 As expected, are all hardcover editions.

CONS
1 Despite my choice being "surprise me", I've never received a horror novel. Maybe a gothic and in some way haunted one, but horror, no.
2 Some books have a pencil marker dot or line on the side. I hate seeing new books ruined like that.
3 At least three books were spy stories. I really do not like politics, wars, and so on, but this is just me, they cannot know it, and the genre end in the box's subject.
4 The first delivery had a nice bookmark in it. For some reason, it was the one and only. From the second delivery, there was a lollipop included, which I suppose it's the "surprise". I'm more for bookmarks to be honest.
label: positive
